targets.authors: Weidmann, Nils B., and Michael Callen.
targets.title: Violence and Election Fraud: Evidence from Afghanistan.
targets.evidence_quote: This study follows Weidmann and Callen (2013) to investigate the relationship between violence and election fraud. While the original study examined cross-sectional observational data from the 2009 Afghan presidential election, the replication study uses data from the 2014 Afghan presidential election.
targets.outcome_quote:
The first two claims (Models 1 & 2, last-digit, logit model) were successfully replicated without any issues. All the measurements and methods used in the replication were basically the same as those used in the original study (also the same as those in the replication study during Phase 1). 
The replication of the last two claims (Models 3 & 4, recount-based, OLS model) outputs mixed outcomes.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Two claims replicated; remaining claims explicitly mixed, with one failed and another conditional on fraud measurement.
